title: Bridge Glb Path Resolution
description: Fix places where bridge.glb and other metabolism representation files resolve to wrong paths (stale assets/semio/metabolism vs fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/representations).
summary: Metabolism mesh files (including bridge.glb) live under semio/fixtures/kit/dev/metabolism/representations, two levels above wip/initialKit. sketchpadKitFileUrlById now resolves GLBs via ../../representations/<name>.glb with normalized paths; removed the parallel hardcoded representations root. Pointed @semio/assets, engine tests, and desktop E2E at the fixtures kit tree instead of the removed semio/assets/semio/metabolism path. Added unit tests for bridge.glb URL resolution.
